 Kylian Mbappe is chasing an incredible record, which he could achieve against Racing Santander. 
 football
 Express newspaper
 31/10/2026 13:00 
 Real Madrid star Kylian Mbappe has been in incredible form since the start of this season.
 The Frenchman comes after a fantastic performance in El Clasico against Barcelona last weekend, where he scored two goals.
 Mbappe experienced a special moment at the "Spotify Camp Nou", where he reached the 100th goal mark with the "Los Blancos" shirt, helping Jose Mourinho's team reduce the difference with the rival to three points.
 According to "Diario AS", Mbappe is now targeting another extraordinary record.
 Having scored against all 23 teams he has faced in La Liga, the 27-year-old has the opportunity to take that tally to 24.
 Since joining Real Madrid in 2024, the Frenchman has scored 67 goals in 75 La Liga appearances. His individual performances have been consistently impressive.
 It is remarkable that every opponent he has faced in La Liga has conceded at least one goal to Mbappe.
 Malaga and Elche are the latest two teams to be added to this list this season.
 Racing Santander are now expected to become the 24th different opponent against which the Frenchman could score in La Liga.
 The team that has conceded the most goals to Mbappe is Real Sociedad. The Basque club have conceded seven goals from the Frenchman, followed by Barcelona with six, while Villarreal and Sevilla have conceded five goals each.
 Mbappe comes into this match in excellent form, having scored six goals and provided one assist in his last five appearances.
 The Frenchman has scored 14 goals in all competitions this season, 11 of which have come in La Liga, putting him in second place in the race for the Pichichi award, which goes to the league's top scorer.
 His importance to the team is also evidenced by the points that "Los Blancos" would have lost in the absence of his goals.
 Without Mbappe's achievements, Mourinho's team would have seven points less in the championship and four points less in the Champions League.
 The Portuguese coach has immense faith in his star player, starting him from the first minute of every match. Furthermore, Mbappe has played more minutes than any other player in the squad.
 The Frenchman will aim to continue his scoring streak against Racing Santander, in the match that will take place on Sunday at the "El Sardinero" stadium.
 Scoring a goal against a 24th different opponent in La Liga would be an incredible record, while it remains to be seen whether Mbappe will achieve this feat against Racing. /GazetaExpress/
